1) Primary objective: is the pilot focused on latency-sensitive real-time inference (user-facing) or batch offline processing (analytics)?
2) Expected concurrent QPS/latency SLOs for the pilot (e.g., target p95 < 300ms)?
3) Any regulatory constraints (PHI allowed? on-prem/VPC requirement?)
4) Budget or procurement timeline we should be aware of for Dedicated/reserved capacity?

- Wed Mar 11, 10:00–10:30am

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Rishi in. Answers below: 

1) Primary objective: real-time, user-facing inference for clinical note summarization and short embeddings for search. Needs to be low-latency.
2) Concurrent QPS: pilot estimate ~25–30 qps; p95 target ~200–300ms. At scale we expect 100–150 qps.
3) Regulatory: PHI will be present during pilot; we need SOC 2 + HIPAA considerations. For production we may want VPC or private deployment.
4) Timeline/budget: procurement kick-off mid-April, pilot in May, production target July. Budget TBD but looking at both hosted and Dedicated options.

The Wed Mar 11 slots are a bit tight — would Thu Mar 12 9:00–9:30am PST work instead? If Rishi can do Thu at 9am that would be our preference.

Also looping Elena (ops) on our side: elena.torres@clearsighthealth.com

Thanks,
Sanjay
